question.text: Delta of a call option measures:

answer.text: The change in option premium for a unit change in the underlying asset price
The change in option premium due to time decay
The change in delta for a unit change in underlying price
The change in premium per percentage change in volatility

explanation.text: The Logic: Delta is defined in the workbook as the change in option premium divided by the unit change in the underlying asset price. It measures how much the option price moves when the underlying moves by one unit. The Trap: Time decay is Theta. Change in delta itself is Gamma. Volatility sensitivity is Vega. Delta specifically measures price sensitivity to the underlying. Note: Gamma, Theta, and Vega are separately defined Greeks in the workbook, each measuring sensitivity to a different factor.
